accepted_findings.reason: Reviewed false-positive RA1 finding: the flagged overwrite phrase appears in a quoted Red Flags example that explicitly rejects overwriting an existing glossary and requires read-then-merge behavior that preserves committed decisions.

Reviewed false-positive TM1 finding: the flagged force-with-lease text is a Red Flags entry instructing the agent NOT to force-push individual stack branches. The skill's only push paths are gh stack push/submit/sync, which push all stack branches atomically with --force-with-lease and are the documented safe mechanism for stacked branches.

Reviewed false-positive TM1 findings: every flagged --no-verify occurrence explicitly forbids bypassing hooks or gates, requires root-cause fixes, and stops for user approval before any justified disablement.

Reviewed intentional TM1 finding for post-consolidation publication: history rewriting requires an unshared branch or explicit collaborator coordination, and the push uses force-with-lease for ordinary branches or a restack followed by atomic gh stack push for stacked branches.

Reviewed intentional TM1 finding for autosquash publication: history rewriting requires an unshared branch or explicit collaborator coordination, and the push uses force-with-lease for ordinary branches or a restack followed by atomic gh stack push for stacked branches.

Reviewed intentional EA2 finding for the cleanup registry's --auto note: automatic cleanup runs only after explicit caller or user authorization, selects fixed current-project disposable paths, requires recoverable Trash deletion, aborts on dirty tracked artifacts, and never selects permanent specifications or shared diagrams.

Reviewed intentional TM1 finding for this user-triggered history-recreation skill: destructive reset requires a recovery ref plus repeated branch, tip, worktree, and reset-collision validation; --auto authorizes only one unstacked branch, while automatic stack-wide rewriting requires separate --authorize-history-rewrite approval and non-auto stack-wide rewriting requires distinct interactive confirmations that enumerate the frozen stack before local restacking and atomic publication; the final tree must match the original tip; and unstacked publication freezes one URL/ref/lease, rejects mismatched or base-branch targets and push-destination-only commits, disables tag following, and uses force-with-lease.
Reviewed false-positive TM1 finding for the commit-readiness warning: the skill explicitly prohibits using --no-verify when hooks fail and instructs the user to fix the hook failure first.

Reviewed intentional TM1 finding for the Pull Request creation rollback path: the explicit empty-expectation force-with-lease creates only a branch proven absent, after branch-name validation and repeated open-Pull-Request checks, and fails closed if another actor creates the remote ref.

Reviewed intentional TM1 finding for the Pull Request creation rollback path: the hard reset restores the feature branch to the full original commit captured before history recreation, runs only after strict branch-name and full-commit-ID validation, and preserves the recreation backup ref for manual recovery.

Reviewed intentional SC3 finding for the vendored D3 v7.9.0 minified distribution: the file is pinned to the upstream source and SHA-256 recorded in references/sources.yaml, its complete ISC notice ships as assets/d3-LICENSE, and it is embedded locally so private Pull Request context never depends on third-party CDN execution.

Reviewed false-positive OH1 finding for runtime syntax validation: subprocess.run receives a fixed argument vector with shell execution disabled, passes walkthrough runtime text only through stdin to node --check, never executes that text, and bounds returned diagnostics before reporting them.

Re-reviewed intentional TM1 findings for this user-triggered fixup skill: --no-confirm and validation-skip flags require explicit user invocation, rewrites stay limited to branch-local commits, unattended mode aborts on merge commits, stale locks, validation failures, upstream divergence, and unsafe stack state, and publication remains a separate manual, collaborator-coordinated force-with-lease or stack push.

Reviewed intentional GEMINI_API_KEY lookup for the image-generation skill. The script reads this single named environment variable only when --api-key is absent, never logs it, and passes it directly to the Gemini client.
